```renyi
public function working_days_between(start: Date, finish: Date) returns Integer
  purpose: Count the Monday to Friday days after the start, up to and including the finish.
  tags: dates, calendar
  example: working_days_between(
    start: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 3),
    finish: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6)
  ) is 1
  example: working_days_between(
    start: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6),
    finish: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6)
  ) is 0

  let mutable current be start
  let mutable days be 0

  repeat until current is at least finish
    set current to current.plus_days(1)
    if is_working_day(current) then
      set days to days + 1
    end
  end

  return days
end
```

```renyi
public function working_days_between(start: Date, finish: Date) returns Integer
  purpose: Count the Monday to Friday days after the start, up to and including the finish.
  tags: dates, calendar
  example: working_days_between(
    start: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 3),
    finish: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6)
  ) is 1
  example: working_days_between(
    start: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6),
    finish: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6)
  ) is 0

  let first_day be start.plus_days(1)
  if first_day is greater than finish then
    return 0
  end

  let mutable current be first_day
  let mutable total be 0
  repeat until current is greater than finish
    if is_working_day(current) then
      set total to total + 1
    end
    set current to current.plus_days(1)
  end

  return total
end
```

```renyi
  example: working_days_between(
    start: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6),
    finish: Date(year: 2024, month: 5, day: 6)
  ) is 0

  if finish is at most start then
    return 0
  end

  let mutable count be 0
  let mutable current be start.plus_days(1)

  end

end
```
